tests.title: Authentication Security Test
tests.description: Tests authentication mechanisms for common security issues like brute force protection
tests.output:
=== Authentication Security Test ===


Test 1: Brute Force Protection
✓ Brute force protection detected after 4 attempts

Test 2: Password Strength Requirements
✗ Password strength requirements not enforced

Test 3: Session Timeout
✗ Error testing session timeout: Request failed with status code 429

=== Authentication Security Test Summary ===

✗ Found 1 authentication vulnerabilities:

Vulnerability #1: Password Strength Requirements
Details: System accepted weak passwords during registration.

Recommendations:
1. Implement rate limiting and account lockout mechanisms to prevent brute force attacks.
2. Enforce password complexity requirements (minimum length, mixed case, numbers, special characters).
3. Set appropriate session timeout values (30-60 minutes max for healthcare applications).
